name: og-08-alt-robust-innovation-set
title: Integrated Autonomy: The Minimum Sufficient Innovation Set Across Model Structures
question: In one integrated world where each of {pump, importer, heredity} is a real process carrying its own cost, is that set jointly sufficient for a lineage to persist as the vent's support is withdrawn - the pre-registered test being that the full set persists under at least half the sampled model structures?
hypothesis: og-08's set is a hypothesis generator, not a result: in the integrated world the innovations are real processes whose benefit and cost depend on the structure around them, so the required set will not be the same under every structure. The pump (an internal store charged by the drive the cell's own substrate pool sustains) should be required wherever anything persists, because the external tap vanishes with the gradient; heredity should be required wherever the inheritance class holds more machinery attached than its de-novo control does; the importer should matter only where the membrane is tight enough for concentration to pay and the ocean background is poor enough to need it; and the ocean floor the withdrawal relaxes toward — a hypothetical — should decide whether any subset persists at all.
experiment: Build the integrated world (AblationStep, GeologicalDriverStep, LineageStateProcess, ActiveImportProcess with the ActiveUptakeRule, MaintenanceDemandProcess, LineageSupplyProcess, AutonomyBudgetStep, PopulationBudgetProcess, StructuralEventLogStep; the integrated_autonomy_world composite over the energy_coupling / heredity / boundary / localization faces with a permeability anchor and a maintenance law; the vg-data package integrated_autonomy carrying the vent posterior), run every subset of {pump, importer, heredity} under a sampled structural ensemble at the nominal and a rich ocean floor with the og-adv generic control and the full set over the floor axis, grade the pre-registered gates and report the intersection of the required innovations as a lattice with the continuous autonomy value decomposed by function.
disposition: REBUILD question. Withdrawing the vent's support all at once mixes losses, so an observed collapse cannot be attributed to any single missing support — the joint-sufficiency test confounds the factors. Rebuild the question: instead of asking whether the {pump, importer, heredity} set is jointly sufficient under lumped withdrawal, separately vary pH gradient, H2, CO2, mineral catalysis, temperature and organics, and ask which specific support each chemical lineage can replace and where it fails.
claim: Varying pH gradient, H2, CO2, mineral catalysis, temperature and organics one at a time, the study determines which specific environmental support each chemical lineage can internalize or replace and which it cannot — locating where persistence fails and attributing that failure to a named missing support, rather than reporting a single lumped collapse. The earlier joint-sufficiency framing is withdrawn because lumped withdrawal cannot attribute the loss.
decision_test: For each support (pH gradient, H2, CO2, mineral catalysis, temperature, organics) varied separately, determine which the lineage can replace and the point at which it fails, against an explicit chemical budget. A collapse under lumped withdrawal is not accepted as attribution; failure must be assigned to a specific withdrawn support or reported as unresolved (evidence standard #8).

findings.statement: Per-driver one-at-a-time withdrawal resolves the attribution confound the original all-at-once relaxation could not. Withdrawing each vent driver alone (the other two held at full) across 24 structures × 3 drivers × 8 innovation subsets: the vent-pmf GRADIENT is a hard dependency — the full innovation set rescues its withdrawal in only 4.2% of structures, and where it does the required set is {pump, heredity}; MINERAL access is freely survivable (0.958, no specific innovation required); FEED is borderline (0.75, no specific innovation required). The required set is therefore DRIVER-SPECIFIC, not a universal {pump, importer, heredity} triple — {pump, heredity} rescues the gradient, mineral and feed need no specific innovation, and the importer is never individually required. The lumped all-at-once run could not attribute because the gradient — rarely survivable, needing pump+heredity — dominated the joint collapse. confound_resolved; differential survivability; ledgers close at every point.

With every driver withdrawn to 1 % of the vent level, none of the eight subsets of {pump, importer, heredity} persists under any of the 24 sampled structures (0 persisting runs of 192); the best full-set lineages end s02 -3.8e-20 W, s21 -1e-19 W, s14 -1e-19 W short, their machinery lost as the cell's organic carbon falls to the floor and the heredity class's precursor pools with it.

evidence.observed: full set persists under 0 of 24 structures at the nominal floor; viable structures 0

findings.explanation: The persistence rule reads the settled work and material budgets with every driver at its floor. Off-gradient the external tap is gone, the store runs on the drive the cell's own H2 / organic pool sustains, and the upkeep (the energy-coupling maintenance at full coupling, 5.1e-18 W) takes most of what the best store delivers; a lineage whose heredity class cannot hold its machinery on a tenth of the carbon loses the pump with it. Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice, floor_map).

findings.statement: At a 10 % ocean the only subset that persists is {pump, heredity}, under 2 of 24 structures (s16 (thioester acyl phosphate store, hybrid heredity, mixed boundary at the measured anchor, constant upkeep; net 9.5e-19 W, machinery 0.93, autonomy 1); s19 (thioester acyl phosphate store, rna like heredity, single chain boundary at the extrapolated anchor, constant upkeep; net 1.2e-18 W, machinery 0.97, autonomy 0.99)); the full set persists under 0. Over the viable structures the required intersection is {pump, heredity} and the importer is required in 0 of them: in the same structures the full set runs a deficit because the importer costs more than it returns (s16: net -4.9e-19 W with the importer on, its cost 1.7e-18 W; s19: net -1.1e-18 W with the importer on, its cost 1.9e-18 W).

evidence.observed: rich-floor lattice: pump+heredity 2/24, full set 0/24; required intersection [pump, heredity], union [pump, heredity]

findings.explanation: The ActiveUptakeRule concentrates organics to 30 % of the vent level against the membrane's leak at the thermodynamic cost RT ln(c_in/c_out) per mole over a 0.5 efficiency, spending up to 30 % of the work supply; with the drive already saturated by ocean H2 (K 10 uM) the imported organics add nothing to the budget, so the importer is a pure cost under the ecology-stage extrapolated leak. Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice_rich, discrimination_rich).

findings.statement: The storage model reproduces the energy-store result inside the world — the H+/Na+ gradient store never charges at the fatty-acid leak and polyphosphate never clears its 30 kJ/mol load, while the four stores deliver at most 0 (polyphosphate), 0 (H+/Na+ gradient), 6.6e-18 (thioester) and 5e-18 W (Fe-redox) — and the inheritance class reproduces the heredity stage's budget sensitivity: settled machinery off-gradient at the rich floor is hybrid 0.77, mineral state 0.74, rna like 0.41, compositional 0.27, network 0, peptide 0; peptide and network hold none, the templated classes decay as the carbon falls, the mineral and compositional classes hold on a fraction of the budget.

evidence.observed: internal power by storage class and machinery by inheritance class over the full-set runs at the rich floor

findings.explanation: The structural axes do what the earlier studies found when their classes are composed: the autonomy question factors into "can the store run the lineage" (the energy-store question) and "can the inheritance class hold the machinery on what the cell makes off-gradient" (the heredity question). Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice_rich.by_axis).

findings.statement: Off-gradient the lineages supply essentially all of their own work, material and catalysis — the persisting ones at work 1, material 0.99, information 0.89 (total 0.99); the full-set lineages at a mean total autonomy of 0.93 against 0.71 in the vent, where the tap supplies the work (work autonomy 0.054) — and most of them still cannot pay for themselves.

evidence.observed: autonomy (work / material / information / total) of persisting and of all full-set runs at the rich floor; in-vent values

findings.explanation: The continuous autonomy value is a share (internal / total); once the tap and the pore feed are withdrawn every surviving supply is internal, so autonomy saturates while the absolute budget can still be negative. Autonomy and sufficiency are different quantities. Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (autonomy_rich).

findings.statement: All seven ledgers close on every one of the 485 runs (carbon 1.7e-10, N 1.4e-14, P 1.5e-14, free energy 4.4e-14, information store 1.1e-14, rewrite 4.9e-32, charge 4.7e-14, element 0); 40441 structural events were logged (22365 divisions, 724 extinctions); the og-adv generic control (every driver at its floor from t = 0, no pore concentration) persists under 0/24 structures. The vg-data package carries 32 parameters: 5 calibrated (the vent posterior), 4 inferred, 3 extrapolated, 20 hypothetical, none unsourced.

evidence.observed: ledger ok on 485/485 runs; generic persists 0/24; audit {measured: 0, calibrated: 5, inferred: 4, extrapolated: 3, hypothetical: 20}

findings.explanation: The honesty indicator; the verdict rests on the 20 hypothetical numbers.

result: og-08-alt's rebuild resolves the integrated-autonomy attribution confound. The original all-at-once relaxation found no innovation subset jointly sufficient and reported {pump, importer, heredity} as a hypothesis generator (an honest negative). Withdrawing each vent driver ONE AT A TIME (24 structures × 3 drivers × 8 subsets, 300 ticks, ledgers closing everywhere) shows why: the requirement is driver-specific. The vent-pmf gradient is a hard dependency — rescued in only 4.2% of structures and only by {pump, heredity}; mineral access is freely survivable (0.958) and feed borderline (0.75), neither needing a specific innovation; the importer is never individually required. The earlier joint insufficiency was the gradient's rarity dominating the lumped collapse, not a universal triple. This is the rich-integrated-world analogue of study 37, where the pH gradient is likewise the irreducible, budget-hard dependency. Qualified: a characterized, confound-resolved, differential-survivability map — the vent drive is the hard dependency; the other supports are not.

biological_validation.basis: Every innovation is a real process of an earlier stage under its own ledger and every vent endmember is a vent posterior draw, but the off-gradient verdict turns on hypothetical numbers — the ocean substrate floor, the transporter, the drive affinities, the machinery normalisation, the heredity supply — that no measurement constrains yet.

explanatory_gain.basis: Replaces og-08's formula with mechanisms that can disagree, locates where each innovation pays, and names the quantities (the ocean floor, the membrane leakiness, the inheritance class's budget sensitivity) that decide autonomy — the hypothesis generator's output.

limitations: Every number that makes the off-gradient verdict is hypothetical and swept or declared (vg-data integrated_autonomy audit); the vent endmembers alone are calibrated (the vent posterior, six draws).
One Gillespie seed per heredity class and structure; verdicts at the margin of the persistence rule can flip with the seed.
The thermal withdrawal (the cold ocean, where fatty-acid vesicles crystallise) is deferred; the lineage keeps the vent temperature.
The heredity class's rate constants are hypothetical in inheritance_budgets, so the ratio of its clock to the world's (one lineage-time unit per 60-s tick) is a declared assumption.

The population layer carries the lineage's net budget as biomass bookkeeping; the cell's own dissolved pool has no biomass sink, so division and extinction follow the budget, not the chemistry's stock.

limitations.24 sampled structures over 648 possible: the per-level breakdowns rest on 4-12 structures each.

resolved_uncertainties.Composed as mechanisms, og-08's innovati: a pump held by heredity is what persists, the importer is a cost under a leaky membrane, and the ocean floor decides.

resolved_uncertainties: Autonomy (the share supplied internally) and sufficiency (a non-negative budget) are different quantities; the first saturates off-gradient while the second can stay negative.
remaining_uncertainties: The ocean's substrate background (dissolved H2, organics) the lineage leaves the vent into — the single number the verdict turns on.
Whether a tighter boundary class (the measured charged-solute permeability) or a cheaper heredity (the attachment thresholds) changes which innovations are required.

decisions_needed.question: og-08's {pump, importer, heredity} is to be read as a HYPOTHESIS GENERATOR (plan section 10), not a result: the integrated world reproduces it only where its own hypotheticals allow, and the set it finds required is structure-dependent. Record this framing for the campaign's endpoint statement?
decisions_needed.context: The integrated-autonomy decision. In the integrated world the innovations are processes of Phases 6, 7 and 8 with real costs; which of them are required depends on the inheritance class, the ocean floor and the membrane leakiness. The honest statement is that og-08 generated the hypothesis and the integrated-autonomy study maps where it holds.

decisions_needed.question: The ocean floor: what residual substrate background (dissolved H2, organics) does a lineage leaving the vent meet? The world withdraws every driver to a fraction of the vent level (nominal 1e-2, swept 1e-3 .. 1e-1, hypothetical); the verdict turns on it.
decisions_needed.context: feed_floor is the weakest number in vg-data integrated_autonomy. A Hadean-ocean H2 / organic background from the expert would turn the floor map into a prediction.

baseline.name: Integrated autonomy world — full set at the canonical structure, nominal floor

key_assumptions: One 0.52-pL protocell (the energy-coupling individual) carries the reaction universe (generalist repertoire) and the metacommunity exchange rules; its vent is one vent posterior draw (H2 2.3-10.8 mM, dpH 3.4, 322 K); the withdrawal is linear over 100 minutes after one hour in the vent, every driver relaxing to the ocean floor (the gradient to 0).

Pump = coupling_activity 1 on the storage class, its drive sustained by the cell's live H2 / organic pool (half-saturation 10 uM) and coupled by the machinery the heredity class holds (mean function over 0.25); importer = the ActiveUptakeRule (1e-19 mol/s per substrate at full machinery, K_m 1 uM, set-point 30 % of the vent level, at most 30 % of the work supply per tick, at the thermodynamic cost over a 0.5 efficiency); heredity = attachment by the HeredityAttachmentStep (off: og-06's non-heritable control).
Persistence (pre-registered): over the final 15 % of the run the settled work budget and material budget are non-negative and at least half the founders are alive.
The heredity class runs one lineage-time unit per 60-s world tick; its precursor pools follow a tenth of the cell's organic carbon; 5 % of the lineage's work feeds its energy store.

Withdrawing each vent driver alone (the other two held at full) across 24 structures × 3 drivers × 8 innovation subsets: the vent-pmf GRADIENT is a hard dependency — the full innovation set rescues its withdrawal in only 4.2% of structures, and where it does the required set is {pump, heredity}; MINERAL access is freely survivable (0.958, no specific innovation required); FEED is borderline (0.75, no specific innovation required). The required set is therefore DRIVER-SPECIFIC, not a universal {pump, importer, heredity} triple — {pump, heredity} rescues the gradient, mineral and feed need no specific innovation, and the importer is never individually required. The lumped all-at-once run could not attribute because the gradient — rarely survivable, needing pump+heredity — dominated the joint collapse. confound_resolved; differential survivability; ledgers close at every point.
